## Published Apple App Store apps

- AgedCare Monitor (Medical, Free)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/agedcare-monitor
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/agedcare-monitor/id6767978725?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.Agedcare-shared
  - Audience: Professional carers, family carers, and aged-care facility staff
  - Summary: A privacy-minded monitoring aid for resident safety workflows, incident review, carer dashboards, and Apple Watch alert support.
- AI Real Investor (Finance, $3.99)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/ai-real-investor
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-real-investor/id6779068906?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.AI-Real-Investor
  - Audience: Property investors and finance decision-makers
  - Summary: A premium workspace for reviewing property signals, investment considerations, and decision-support outputs before acting.
- CareLens Aged+ (Medical, $7.99)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/carelens-aged
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/carelens-aged/id6767072418?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.Carelens-Aged-
  - Audience: Clinicians, facility managers, and aged-care teams
  - Summary: Designed for teams working with ageing, dementia, care planning, and resident-support workflows.
- LegalAid (Productivity, $0.49)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/legalaid
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/legalaid/id6782532109?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.LegalAid
  - Audience: People and legal professionals preparing legal-information workflows
  - Summary: Structure legal facts, review pasted document text, identify risk signals, prepare jurisdiction-aware prompts, and generate draft reports for qualified review.
- PeaceLens (Education, $3.99)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/peacelens
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/peacelens/id6776995376?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.PeaceLens
  - Audience: Researchers, journalists, election observers, trainers, and policy teams
  - Summary: Capture media reports, score coverage with an explainable Peace Journalism Index, compare findings, and prepare research outputs.
- Prop-Valulator (Lifestyle, $0.49)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/prop-valulator
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/prop-valulator/id6780286834?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.Prop-Valulator
  - Audience: Homeowners, property watchers, and valuation explorers
  - Summary: Explore property value signals with AI-powered graph inference and heuristic valuation support.
- PsychoLogic (Medical, $7.99)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/psychologic
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/psychologic/id6778269526?uo=4
  - Bundle ID: wcs.PsychoLogic
  - Audience: Journal users and reflective wellbeing workflows
  - Summary: A general-purpose journal for recording experiences and reflecting on patterns without replacing professional care.
- Psychosocial Analytics (Medical, $14.99)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/psychosocial-analytics
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/psychosocial-analytics/id6768490648?uo=4

- TruthLens Global (News, $9.99)
  - Landing page: https://worldclassscholars.vercel.app/apple-apps/truthlens-global
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/truthlens-global/id6776208825?uo=4

- WCS Agentic (Business, Free)

- WCS-GEO (Business, $9.99)
